tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /myur rtsis rnam dag skyon med nyer mkho kun gsal bzhugs so// na maḥshrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rigs brgya'i bdag po rje btsun mchog /phyi nang gzhan gyi dus 'khor lo/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar brtag brten nas/ /skyon med myur rtsis gsal bar bshad/ /kun 'dzin la sogs 'das pa'i lo/ /nyi mas bsgyur la 'das zla bsre/ /gnas gnyis 'og ma mig gis bsgyur/ /klu me byin la mda' ros bgo /rnyed pa steng byin zla dag go /zla dag gnas gsum steng rim bzhin/ /zla ba zla me mkha' mdas bsgyur/ /dus dang zla mig mkha' mtshos brgyan/ /'og nas mkha' ros rim bzhin dril/ /steng ma ris dor gza' rgyu'o/ /zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma ni/ /mig gis bsgyur la mi bdag byin/ /'og ma dus srin sbyin byas nas/ /dus nyis bgos lhag cha shas gnas/ /steng ma klu lag gis bgos ril/ /zla dag gnas lnga yas rim ltar/ /mig phyogs klu mda' lag phyogs kyi/ /bsgyur nas mas rim yon tan dang / /me zla srin gzugs dus mig byin/ /rang rang 'khor los steng du dril/ /'khor los bgos lhag nyi rgyu'o/ /sgyur byed so sor byin pa yi/ /zla ba phyi ma'i rgyu bar 'gyur/ /de nas nyin rtsis bya ba'i phyir/ /gza' rgyur tshes kyi re mig byin/ /ril por tshes bsre chu zlas bgo /brnyes pa mnyam par logs su bri/ /lhag mas cha shas re mig gzung / /gza' yi chu tshod man chad du/ /rnyed pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dbri/ /de la gza' bar zhes su grags/ /nyi rgyur nyi ma'i rtags longs sbyin/ /nye bar de nyid gnas gnyis bgo /gcig la skar mar drug dang ni/ /chu tshod gnas nas mda' chu dor/ /ma ldang 'khor lo mnan la sbyangs/ /'khor phyed lhag na dor ba nyid/ /dor na byang bgrod ma dor lho/ /lhag ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros bsgyur/ /'og gi chu tshod bsres pa la/ /zla yon zla rnyed nyi rkang 'dzin/ /rkang 'dzin thad kyi rkang sdom rnams/

/rkang 'dzin phyis pa'i shul du bri/ /ma zos sngon mas lhag rnams bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas thob yang dag rgyu/ /de lhag mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ /'og gi srang bsres thob pa bsrang / /yang lhag ros bsgyur dbugs bcug nas/ /thob pa dbugs bzhag lhag 'dod bsgyur/ /'og gi cha bsres thob cha'o/ /rkang mtshams ma 'das chu tshod bsres/ /'das na yang dag rgyu ba yi/ /rkang sdom chu tshod la sbyangs shing / /de 'og rim bzhin phab la sbyangs/ /gza' skar chu tshod man chad du/ /byang bgrod byin zhing lho bgrod dor/ /nyi dag gnas gnyis cig la ni/ /zla ba'i re mig sbyin par bya/ /tshes 'khyud zla ba zhes su grags/ /gza' yi chu tshod man chad kyi/ /de yi chu tshod la sogs sbyangs/ /gza' skar gnas su thob pa na/ /ri dang 'khor los dor ba dag /nyi zla bsres pas sbyor ba ste/ /byed pa re mig nyid la ltos/ /gza' skar sbyor byed yan lag lnga'o/ /zla phyed sgra gcan rtsi 'dod na/ /zla ba dag par mi klu bsre/ /lag bsgyur nya gcig stong gnyis byin/ /mkha' ro mtshos rnyed dor lhag la/ /skar mas bsgyur te mkha' ro mtshos/ /rnyed pa skarama'o lhag mkha' ros/ /bsgyur rnyed dbyug gu lhag ma ni/ /mkha' ros bsgyur zhing rnyed pa bsrang / /lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs/ /lhag ma dus mtshos bsgyur rnyed ni/ /dus mtsho'i cha ste rtsa ba'o/ /'khor lo la sbyangs gdong yin la/ /de la 'khor phyed bsres pa 'jug /sgra gcan rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /de nas gza' lnga rtsi ba'i tshe/ /zla ba dag pa mkha' mes bsgyur/ /'das zhag bsres la gnas gsum bkod/ /'og dmar mtsho 'byung ro byin zhing / /bar pa chu dbang byin nas kyang / /'og ma ri mkha' ri yi bgo /rnyed pa bar bsres chu ros bgo /des brnyes steng sbyangs mi gsal zhag /de nyid gnas gnyis bkod nas kyang / /'og ma thub pas bgos lhag de/ /tshes 'di'i re gza' mthun na dag /mi mthun gcig gnyis gang rung gi/

/nyung bsnan mang dbri steng mar bya/ /gza' lnga spyi'i gsal bzhag yin/ /da ni mig dmar rtsi 'dod na/ /gsal bzhag dus klus brgyan pa la/ /ri klu ros bgos rnyed nor dor/ /lhag ma rgyu skar 'khor los bsgyur/ /ri klu ros thob skar ma'o/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur rnyed dbyug /yang lhag mkha' ros bsgyur rnyed bsrang / /de lhag ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs/ /lhag ma byung na 'dod pas bsgyur/ /ri klu ros thob 'dod cha'o/ /de ni mig dmar dal bar yin/ /gnas gnyis byas te cig bshos la/ /skar mar bu ga chu tshod du/ /mkha' me sbyangs la ma ldang na/ /'khor lo bsnan sbyangs 'khor phyed tshad/ /lhag na'ang sbyangs par bya ba yin/ /dor na rim min dal bar snon/ /ma dor rim pa dal bar dbri/ /lhag ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros bsgyur/ /'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa/ /'byung me zlas thob dal rkang bzung / /rkang 'dzin thad kyi rkang sdom rnams/ /rkang 'dzin phyis pa'i shul du bri/ /rkang pa 'dzin tshul nyi zlar mtshungs/ /ma zos sngon mas lhag rnams bsgyur/ /rang rang 'khor los steng du dril/ /steng ma 'byung mes bzlas thob pa/ /yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ /'og gi srang bsre thob pa bsrang / /de lhag ros bsgyur 'og ma bcug /rnyed pa dbugs yin yang lhag ni/ /'dod bsgyur cha bcug thob cha'o/ /rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na/ /chu tshod gnyis po bsre la bya/ /'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis/ /rkang sdom chu tshod dag la sbyangs/ /de las gcig phab drug cus bsgyur/ /chu srang gis sbyangs lhag ma rnams/ /rim par phab la so sor sbyangs/ /dal bar rim dbri rim min snon/ /de ni mig dmar dal dag yin/ /dal ba dag pa gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis nyi ma bar pa sbyangs/ /ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la dor/ /'khor lo bsnan nam ma bsnan yang / /'khor byed lhag na dor bar bya/ /dor na rim min dal dag phri/

/lhag mas myur rkang lugs ldog bzung / /ma dor rim pa dal dag snon/ /lhag mas myur rkang lugs 'byung bzung / /rkang 'dzin thad kyi rkang sdom rnams/ /rkang 'dzin phyis pa'i bshum du bris/ /ma zos sngon mas lhag rnams bsgyur/ /rang rang 'khor los steng du dril/ /steng ma mkha' ros rnyed dbyug gu /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba ma/ /'og gi srang bcug thob pa sogs/ /dal rkang bzhin du rim pas sbyar/ /rkang mtshams ma 'das chu tshod bsre/ /'das na rim pas phab la dbri/ /steng ma mkha' ros thob na bgo /dal dag nyim snon rim min dbri/ /gal te dbri bya nyung gyur na/ /dbri byas dbri byed dbri bar bya/ /de ne mig dmar myur dag yin/ /ma dor ma rgal myur bar bshags/ /rgal la ma dor dal 'gros lho/ /dor ma ma brgal 'khyog po nub/ /rgal dor 'byung 'gros byang du blta/ /'gros bzhi 'di nyid kun la mtshungs/ /de nas phur bu spen pa gnyis/ /cho ga phal cher gong dang 'dra/ /phur bu'i gsal bzhag bu ga dang / /klu dang drag pos rgyan pa la/ /so me rgya mtsho rnyed pa dor/ /spen pa'i gsal bzhag 'byung ba dang / /mkha' mdas brgyan la ro dus ri/ /mkha' dang zla bas bgos rnyed dor/ /lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs/ /snga ma ltar byas dal bar yin/ /da ni gnas gnyis bkod pa la/ /phur bu'i skar mas nyi ma dang / /spen pa la ni nyes pa sbyongs/ /ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan sogs 'dra/ /zhi gza' gnyis po bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma bar pa gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig la skyes khyim sbyangs bya ste/ /lhag pa'i skar ma mi bdag dang / /chu tshod sum cu dbri bar bya/ /pa sangs la ni nyi dag ni/ /skar ma'i gnas nas drug sbyang ngo / /ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan sogs mtshungs/ /nyi ma bar par sbyin dor bya/ /zhi gza' gnyis kyi dal dag yin/ /lhag pa'i gsal bzhag brgya yis bsgyur/ /mda' dus bu ga ri bos brgyan/ /ri bug ri klus bgos thob dor/

/pa sangs gsal bzhag phyogs kyis bsgyur/ /'byung ri nyi mas brgyan pa la/ /ri rgyal mig gi bgos thob dor/ /lhag ma 'khor lo bsgyur ba sogs/ /dal myur cho ga snga mas shes/ /dal rkang rim dang rim min cig /myur rkang rim pa kun 'byung dang / /rim min lugs bzlog ma nor bzung / /so so'i myur ba dag par 'gyur/ /da ni byed pa lo 'pho dang / /zla ba'i bdag po'i gza' rnams ni/ /shes phar bya phyir 'di ltar bya/ /kun 'dzin la sogs 'das pa'i lor/ /ro dang bu gas brgyan pa la/ /srin bug rtse mos bsgyur byas te/ /ri zla me yi bgos rnyed ni/ /logs su bzhag cing lhag ma yang / /mkha' ro mkha' ro ro dang ni/ /ri zla me yi rim bzhin bsgyur/ /so sor lo 'pho'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ri zla mes bgos lhag med cing / /thob pa'i nor rnams chu tshod dang / /chu klung dbugs dang dkyil 'khor cha'o/ /gza' yi gnas su mig byin zhing / /chu tshod gnas su mkha' me byin/ /thob na drug cus bgos pa'i nor/ /steng du byin la thub pas bgo /lhag ma lo de'i bdag po'i gza'/ /gza' dang gzugs dang dbyug gur tshes/ /chu srang gzugs med dbugs su gzugs/ /ri zla me yi cha shas su/ /zla nyi byin pas phyi ma 'char/ /gza' re shar nas sdod pa'i yun/ /dus klu mig gi zhag dang ni/ /zhib par rjes 'brang cung zad yod/ /rags par byed na snga ma'i zhag /kho nar nges pa'i 'pho mtshams ni/ /shes par bya phyir lo bdag gza'i/ /chu tshod gang shar gnas gnyis bkod/ /steng ma chu bo 'og ma la/ /dus chus bsgyur nas mkha' ros bgo /thob pa steng du byin pa de/ /gcig tsam 'das pa'i zhag yin zhing / /'das pa'i zhag grangs de nyid kyi/ /dus klu mig gi zhag la sbyangs/ /lhag ma ma 'ongs zhag grangs yin/ /grangs de rdzogs rjes lo bdag la/ /lo bdag bdun pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /nyi ma mig dmar spen pa gsum/ /sdig pa'i gza' ste cung zad ngan/

/zla lhag phur pa pa sangs rnams/ /dge ba'i gza' te cung zad bzang / /de nas zla bdag brtsi ba'i phyir/ /lo bdag gza' dang chu tshod ni/ /bcu gnyis gnas bzhag khyim rnams kyi/ /rtags mtshan 'phrul med byas nas kyang / /lug la zla ba ri 'byung sbyin/ /rig byed me dbang glang la'o/ /gzugs dang ri mda' 'khrig par snon/ /mtsho dang me 'byung karka ṭa/ /gzugs dang lag mig seng ge la/ /bu mo rig byed rgyal ba sbyin/ /ro dang gzugs dbang srang la ste/ /zla ba ri chu sdig pa la/ /me dang mi bdag gzhu la byin/ /rig byed ri me chu srin la/ /dus dang rgya mtsho bum pa bsnan/ /mkha' dang mig 'byung nya la'o/ /chu tshod mkha' ros bgos la bcug /steng ma ris dor zla ba'i bdag /bzang ngan 'bras bu snga ma shes/ /dus sbyor nges par shes bya'i phyir/ /shambha la dang kai la sha/ /rgya nag li bod 'phags yul te/ /yul drug so sor dus sbyor ni/ /'char tshul mi 'dra shambha lar/ /nyi dag gang yin de nyid de/ /gzhan rnams skar rkang re re bsnan/ /de yi dus sbyor rags pa rtogs/ /khyad par phyogs 'dir nyer mkho'i phyir/ /bod yul dus sbyor rtsi 'dod na/ /nyi mar gzugs byin yang na ni/ /nyi dag gzugs bsres mkha' ros bsgyur/ /'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa/ /'byung me zlas thob 'das pa'i khyim/ /lhag ma mkha' mes bsgyur ba la/ /chu srang mig gi bgos thob gzhug /'byung me zlas thob 'das pa'i zhag /lhag ma mkha' ro mkha' ro dang / /ro dang 'dod pas bsgyur rnyed rnams/ /rim bzhin chu tshod la sogs su/ /nyi ma gnas pa'i khyim de yi/ /'char yun chu tshod gang yin de/ /'das zhag bsgyur la mkha' mes bgo /thob pa nam langs snga rol du/ /khyim de'i 'das pa'i chu tshod yin/ /de yi 'char yun chu tshod la/ /phri ba'i lag ma ma 'ongs pa'o/ /'char yun chu tshod re mig ltos/ /nyi ma gnas pa nas brtsams pa'i/ /khyim drug sdom pa nyin mo'i tshad/

/gzhan drug mtshan mo'i tshod yin no/ /nyin mo'i khyim gsum snga dro dang / /de rjes khyim gsum phyi dro'i tshad/ /mtshan mo'ang de'i rigs pas sbyar/ /'das zhag chu srang bzhi yi bsgyur/ /mkha' ros bgos thob nyin mtshan la/ /byang bgrod la byin lho bgrod dang / /de yis mkha' ror phri ba'i lhag /rang rang mtshan mo'i tshad du 'gyur/ /da ni tatkāl brtsi 'dod na/ /thub shing grib ma'i 'god gzhi ni/ /chu srin snga gro phyi dro dag /mtshungs par chu tshod dus dang tshes/ /bum snga gzhu phyi nor lha cha/ gzhu snga bum phyi rgya mtsho yi/ /nya dang sdig pa'i snga dro dang / /phyi dro mtshungs par rigs byed tshe/ /lug snga srang phyi nam mkha' nyi/ /srang lnga lug phyi nam mkha' skyon/ /glang snga bu mo'i phyi dro dang / /klu phyogs bu mo'i phyi dro dang / /glang gi phyi dro nam mkha' skyon/ /'khrig snga seng phyi nyi zla ste/ /seng snga 'khrig phyi thig le cha/ /karka snga phyi dus nyi'o/ /de la thub pa'i shing bu ni/ /grib mar bcas pas bgo bar bya/ /thob pa'i nor ni chu tshod de/ /snga dro ri mor gang shar nyi/ /'das pa yin pas 'char yun gyi/ /chu tshod rnams kyi rim bzhin dbri/ /phri bar ma ldang tatkā la/ /phyi dro yin na gang shar de/ /ma 'ongs 'byon rgyu yin pas na/ /de'i nyin mo'i tshad la dbri/ /phri ba'i lhag ma 'das pa ste/ /'char yun chu tshod rim bzhin sbyangs/ /ma ldang lhag ma tatkā la/ /gal te sbyangs bya nyung ba na/ /sbyangs byas sbyang byed phri ba'i lhag /dus sbyor de yi lus pa'o/ /de ltar myur rtsis rnam dag cing / /nye bar mkho ba kun tshang 'di/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i lo tsā ba/ /ānanda yis nye bar sbyar/ /dge bas mtha' yas lus can kun/ /mi shes dri ma kun bsal te/ /ye shes snang ba cher rgyas pa'i/ /rdo rje bzhi ldan myur thob shog/ //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/
